source.documentName: CBSE Secondary School Curriculum 2024-25 - Mathematics (Subject Code 041)

chapters.title: Real Numbers
chapters.description: Review of representation of natural numbers, integers, and rational numbers on number line. Rational numbers as recurring/terminating decimals. Operations on real numbers, laws of exponents with integral and rational exponents, rationalisation of real numbers.

levels.title: Irrational Numbers & Decimal Expansions
levels.description: Non-terminating non-recurring decimals, representing square roots on the number line using geometric spirals.
subtopics: Representation of non-terminating decimals in p/q form

levels.title: Operations on Real Numbers & Rationalisation
levels.description: Rationalising denominators of the form 1/(a + b*sqrt(x)) and laws of real exponents.
subtopics: Laws of exponents for real bases

levels.title: Unit I Review & Exemplar Questions
levels.description: Comprehensive review of real numbers and exponent problem solving.

chapters.title: Polynomials
chapters.description: Definition of polynomial in one variable, coefficients, terms, degree of polynomial, zero polynomial, Remainder and Factor theorems, factorisation of quadratic and cubic polynomials, algebraic identities.

levels.title: Polynomial Terminology & Zeroes
levels.description: Degrees of polynomials, finding zeroes, and verifying solutions.

levels.title: Factor Theorem & Factorisation
levels.description: Splitting the middle term of ax^2 + bx + c and factoring cubics using factor theorem.

levels.title: Algebraic Identities
levels.description: Using algebraic identities (x+y+z)^2, (x±y)^3, x^3+y^3+z^3-3xyz to evaluate numerical and algebraic expressions.

chapters.title: Linear Equations in Two Variables
chapters.description: Recall of linear equations in one variable, introduction to equation in two variables ax + by + c = 0, solutions of a linear equation, and graphical representation.

levels.title: Solutions of Linear Equations
levels.description: Expressing in form ax + by + c = 0, finding infinitely many solutions (x, y).
subtopics: Finding solutions of ax + by = c
Equations of lines parallel to axes

levels.title: Graph of Linear Equations & Word Problems
levels.description: Plotting linear equations on Cartesian plane and real-life modeling problems.

chapters.title: Coordinate Geometry
chapters.description: The Cartesian plane, coordinates of a point, names and terms associated with coordinate plane, notations, plotting points in the plane.

levels.title: Cartesian Plane & Quadrants
levels.description: Origin, x-axis, y-axis, abscissa, ordinate, and locating points.

chapters.title: Lines and Angles
chapters.description: Basic terms and definitions, intersecting lines and non-intersecting lines, pairs of angles, parallel lines and a transversal, angle sum property of a triangle.

levels.title: Pairs of Angles & Transversals
levels.description: Linear pair axiom, vertically opposite angles, corresponding and alternate interior angles.

chapters.title: Triangles
chapters.description: Congruence of triangles, criteria for congruence (SAS, ASA, AAS, SSS, RHS), properties of triangles (angles opposite to equal sides are equal).

levels.title: Criteria for Congruence of Triangles
levels.description: SAS, ASA, SSS, and RHS congruence criteria with proofs and applications.

chapters.title: Quadrilaterals & Circles
chapters.description: Properties of a parallelogram, midpoint theorem; chords, angle subtended by a chord, perpendicular from the centre to a chord, cyclic quadrilaterals.

levels.title: Midpoint Theorem & Parallelogram Properties
levels.description: Proof of the Midpoint Theorem and properties of diagonals in parallelograms.

levels.title: Circles & Cyclic Quadrilaterals
levels.description: Equal chords and their distances from center, angle subtended by an arc at the center, properties of cyclic quadrilaterals.
subtopics: Angle subtended at center vs circumference
Opposite angles of cyclic quadrilaterals sum to 180

chapters.title: Heron's Formula & Surface Areas and Volumes
chapters.description: Area of a triangle using Heron's formula; surface areas and volumes of spheres (including hemispheres) and right circular cones.

levels.title: Heron's Formula for Area of Triangles
Surface Areas and Volumes of Cones & Spheres
levels.description: Curved surface area and total surface area of cones, spheres, hemispheres, and volume formulas.

chapters.title: Statistics
chapters.description: Bar graphs, histograms (with varying base lengths), and frequency polygons.

levels.title: Graphical Representation of Data
levels.description: Constructing and interpreting bar graphs, histograms, and frequency polygons.
subtopics: Histograms with uniform and varying class intervals
